private_plan.insurer: Eight Swiss insurers (HelloSafe table: Concordia, Groupe Mutuel, Helsana, Visana, KPT, Axa, Sanitas, CSS)
private_plan.terms: In-patient only: semi-private ward (two-bed room) and free choice of doctor in the listed hospitals; no out-patient. Cantons, ages and deductibles not stated by the source.
private_plan.pricing: HelloSafe table, monthly CHF per person: 82.60, 119.40, 119.80, 138.80, 148.50, 148.80, 149, 150.50; median 143.65, x2 = 287.30. The page states no age, sex or canton, so a 45-year-old may pay more: Liechtenstein's FKB tariff for ages 41-50 is 244 a month each (see li.json). Weak.
